title: Support Console: Saved Replies Style Guide
author: Owen Phillips
body:
## Purpose
Saved replies keep common answers consistent. This guide covers how to write one; it doesn't set policy.

## Rules
- Lead with the answer, then the detail.
- Name the next step and who takes it.
- Never put an amount, a date or a limit in a saved reply: they change, and the policy pages are the source.
- Review each saved reply when the page it summarizes changes.

## Examples
- "Thanks for flagging the two lines. I'm checking them in the console now."
- "Usage can take a short while to show in the Console. I'll tell you when to check again."

_Last reviewed 2026-03-09._
